name: fraktul
description: An explorable map of a software system: one model file, diagrams you dive into down to the source, guided and voiced tours.
author: Rinsesoft (https://fraktul.dev)

scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.ts && node bin/fraktul.ts check example/model.yaml && node bin/fraktul.ts check example/shop/model.yaml
scripts.site:build: FRAKTUL_SITE=1 BASCIK_SITE_URL=https://fraktul.dev node bin/fraktul.ts build example/model.yaml --out site-dist && npm run fraktuls:build
scripts.site:build:preview: FRAKTUL_SITE=1 FRAKTUL_PREVIEW=1 node bin/fraktul.ts build example/model.yaml --out site-dist && npm run fraktuls:build
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run site:build:preview && wrangler versions upload --preview-alias "$(node .github/scripts/preview-alias.mjs "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" fraktul)"
scripts.fraktuls:build: FRAKTUL_HOME=/fraktuls FRAKTUL_URL=https://fraktul.dev/fraktuls/fraktul/ node bin/fraktul.ts build example/model.yaml --out site-dist/fraktuls/fraktul && FRAKTUL_URL=https://fraktul.dev/fraktuls/shop/ node bin/fraktul.ts build example/shop/model.yaml --out site-dist/fraktuls/shop && cp src/site/_redirects site-dist/_redirects
